title: Technology Sector Update for 11/26/2018: DTRM,JKS,IPAS
text:

CSCO +2.13%

Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding over 1.0% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 0.7%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Determine ( DTRM ) popped nearly 3% higher on Monday after the software-as-a-service company said European roofing suppier VM Building Solutions has been managing all of its direct and indirect procurement orders on the company's Determine Cloud Platform since April. VM Building began rollout of the procurement, financial management and invoice processing system in France and Belgium, the companies said, and has now placed more than 20,000 orders by over 200 individual users.
In other sector news:
(+) JinkoSolar ( JKS ) raced over 15% higher in afternoon trading Monday after the photovoltaic panels company reported improved Q3 financial results compared with year-ago levels. Excluding one-time items, the company earned RMB5.28, or about $0.76, per American depositary share, up from RMB0.76 per ADS during the same quarter last year and crushing the Capital IQ consensus call expecting a $0.15 per ADS adjusted profit, if comparable. Revenue grew to RMB6.69 billion, or about $974.8 million, from RMB6.42 billion last year and also topping the $934.7 million analyst mean.
(-) iPass ( IPAS ) was down more than 5% despite saying pre-market Monday that it has signed a seven-figure deal to license its iPass SmartConnect Wi-Fi connectivity systems to German telecommunications firm Deutsche Telekom. The companies also are planning to expand their existing relationship to work on creating a dedicated "platform-on-demand" using iPass Smart and managed by Deutsche Telekom as a private cloud.
